_comment: Persistent landmark layer. Positions are strategic-map coordinates and NEVER change between universes. known_at_start landmarks are on the map from day one; the rest are discovered by completing an expedition to a neighbouring landmark.

emberfall.name: Emberfall
emberfall.description: What is left of home. The only place the curse will return you to.

ashen_crossroads.name: Ashen Crossroads
ashen_crossroads.description: A burned waystation where three old roads meet. Marauders pick over the wreckage.

greywood_edge.name: Greywood Edge
greywood_edge.description: Where the Marches give way to the old forest. Timber, forage, and things that wait in the wet.

cinder_pass.name: Cinder Pass
cinder_pass.description: The Legion's road out of the Wastes. Scrap iron and worse.

aurel_border_fort.name: Aurel Border Fort
aurel_border_fort.description: The Crown's eye on the Marches. Its hinterland is patrolled and picked clean.

sunken_chapel.name: Sunken Chapel
sunken_chapel.description: A flooded shrine from before the Kingdoms. Something still keeps watch below.
